context: An elderly couple reflects on changes in their neighborhood
purpose: Teach: いっそう/気が付い/解ら/みえ/陽気/続々/絶えず/浮上

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: この辺りも、ここ数年でいっそう変わってしまったなあ。
lines.en: This area has changed even more these past few years, hasn't it.
lines.style: Wistful elderly male voice, slow reflective pace, gentle nostalgic tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当にねえ。先週ふと気が付いたら、駅前の八百屋さんがもう無くなっていたの。
lines.en: Truly. Last week I suddenly noticed the greengrocer by the station was already gone.
lines.style: Soft grandmotherly voice, mild surprise, warm and slightly sad delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、あそこのご主人、いつも陽気に挨拶してくれていたよなあ。
lines.en: Ah yes, the owner there always greeted us so cheerfully.
lines.style: Fond reminiscing tone, low gravelly elderly male, warm chuckle underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: それが急に閉店だなんて、私には事情がよく解らないわ。
lines.en: For it to suddenly close like that, I really can't understand the circumstances.
lines.style: Puzzled gentle grandmother, slight worry, soft trailing intonation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 代わりに新しいマンションが続々と建って、知らない顔ばかりみえるようになったよ。
lines.en: Instead, new apartment buildings keep going up one after another, and only unfamiliar faces appear.
lines.style: Slightly resigned older male, observational, measured pacing with a sigh.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 景色が絶えず変わっていくから、昔の道を歩いている気がしなくて。
lines.en: Because the scenery keeps changing constantly, it doesn't feel like walking the old paths.
lines.style: Melancholy grandmother voice, soft and contemplative, gentle pauses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 町内会でも、再開発の話が最近浮上しているらしいぞ。
lines.en: Apparently even in the neighborhood association, redevelopment talk has surfaced recently.
lines.style: Informative older male, quiet concern, slightly lowered confidential tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あらまあ。せめて、あの古い桜の木だけは残してほしいわねえ。
lines.en: Oh my. At the very least, I'd like them to leave that old cherry tree standing.
lines.style: Tender grandmother voice, hopeful but worried, soft sigh at the end.
